title: Explicit water-ligand docking, drug-likeness and molecular dynamics simulation analysis to predict the potency of Boerhavia diffusa plant extract against mutant wilms tumor-1 protein responsible for type 4 nephrotic syndrome.
authors: Sahu, Sibani; Moharana, Maheswata; Das, Anuradha; Mishra, Biswajit; Sahu, Satya Narayan
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟分析植物化合物与突变WT1蛋白（含DNA结合域）的结合，但对象是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但核心体系偏离课题。
abstract: Thestructure and function of a protein are closely connected. Changes in a protein structure can impact on its function. Nephrotic syndrome type 4 (NPHS4) is an uncommon genetic condition caused by mutations in the WT1 gene, which codes for the wilms tumor-1 protein. Several studies have discovered that patients with nephrotic syndromes are resistant to steroid therapy and are likely to develop end-stage renal failure. The use of phytochemicals-based therapeutics is in demand due to their high potential and low toxicity. Based on this context, we employed the Autodock raccoon to screen 67 distinct potent phytochemicals from the Boerhavia diffusa (B.diffusa) plant against the wild type and mutant model at position C388R (cysteine is replaced with arginine at position 388) of the C-terminal DNA binding domain of the wilms tumor-1 protein. Out of 67 active compounds, only 10 compounds (lunamarine, kaempferol, boeravinone B, boeravinone E, boeravinone A, boeravinone F, boeravinone J, boeravinone P, boerhaavic acid and 4',7-dihydroxy-3'-methylflavone) were screened based on drug-likeness properties and binding energy for explicit water ligand docking against wild and mutant model of C-terminal DNA binding domain of wilms tumor-1 protein. Consequently, the hydrated form of boeravinone F and boeravinone A demonstrated the highest binding energy against the protein mutant model described above, the binding energies were -9.56 and -8.96 Kcal/mol, respectively. Followed by explicit water ligand docking the microscopic properties of wild type, mutant, mutant-boeravinone F complex, and mutant-boeravinone A complex systems were evaluated using molecular dynamics simulation steps with 100 ns of trajectory. The findings indicate that, due to mutation the mutant model system had decreasing stability and decreasing compactness nature. However, boeravinone A effectively monitored the mutant system's stability and improved compactness nature after binding with the mutant model. Boeravinone A with the mutant model complex system was determined to have the lowest energy point as compared to other studied systems. The study revealed minimal structural alterations and reduced conformational mobility.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质的结构与功能密切相关。蛋白质结构的改变可影响其功能。肾病综合征4型（NPHS4）是一种由WT1基因突变引起的罕见遗传性疾病，该基因编码wilms tumor-1蛋白。多项研究发现，肾病综合征患者对类固醇治疗具有耐药性，并可能发展为终末期肾衰竭。基于植物化学物质的治疗因其高潜力和低毒性而受到需求。在此背景下，我们采用Autodock raccoon从黄细心（B.diffusa）植物中筛选了67种不同的有效植物化学物质，针对wilms tumor-1蛋白C端DNA结合域野生型及C388R位置突变模型（第388位半胱氨酸被精氨酸替代）进行筛选。在67种活性化合物中，仅10种化合物（lunamarine、山柰酚、boeravinone B、boeravinone E、boeravinone A、boeravinone F、boeravinone J、boeravinone P、boerhaavic acid和4',7-二羟基-3'-甲基黄酮）基于药物相似性性质和结合能筛选出来，用于针对wilms tumor-1蛋白C端DNA结合域野生型和突变模型的显式水配体对接。结果表明，水合形式的boeravinone F和boeravinone A对上述蛋白突变模型表现出最高的结合能，结合能分别为-9.56和-8.96 Kcal/mol。随后，通过显式水配体对接，利用分子动力学模拟步骤（100 ns轨迹）评估了野生型、突变型、突变型-boeravinone F复合物和突变型-boeravinone A复合物系统的微观性质。研究发现，由于突变，突变模型系统的稳定性和紧致性均有所下降。然而，boeravinone A在与突变模型结合后，有效维持了突变系统的稳定性并改善了紧致性。与其他研究系统相比，boeravinone A与突变模型复合物系统被确定为具有最低能量点。该研究揭示了最小的结构改变和降低的构象流动性。
